title: fix(cloud-connection,spec): cite the cloud control-plane decisions as `cloud ADR-NNNN`, not bare numbers that resolve to this repo's own records
body:
Fixes #18762

Clause-②: no

Prime Directive 13 requires a cloud decision to be cited as `cloud ADR-NNNN`, "never as a bare number, which `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` resolves against *this* registry (the two number independently)". The rule landed; the stock already in the tree was never swept. This sweeps it, on the file surface the dispatch named.

19 citations gain the `cloud` qualifier. No behaviour, type, export, route or schema moves — citation spelling and prose only.

## The spelling, taken from the precedent

The same-shape card the issue names is #18685, landed in PR #18754. Its changeset states the convention verbatim:

> AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13 is explicit — an ADR "lives in the repository whose code it governs", and a cloud decision is cited as `cloud ADR-NNNN`, "never as a bare number".

Mechanically, that PR inserted the qualifier adjacent to the id and changed nothing else around it: `(cloud, post-ADR-0025)` became `(cloud, post-cloud ADR-0025)`. This PR does the same — a bare `cloud` token immediately before the number, on the same line, surrounding prose byte-identical.

That form is also the only one the gate recognises. `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` parses `ADR_CITATION = /(?:([A-Za-z0-9_./-]+)[ \t]+)?ADR-(\d{4})/g` and exempts only `CROSS_REPO_QUALIFIERS = new Set(['objectui', 'object-ui', 'cloud'])`, so the qualifier must be the token immediately before the id with only spaces or tabs between. Card #18761, which measured that the exemption face is narrower than this repo's prose habits, is open and is not addressed here — this PR deliberately stays inside the recognised form rather than adding to the set it reports on.

## Site one — bare `ADR-0008` in `@objectstack/cloud-connection`

The card grades this one 「成色强」.

Re-derived on `origin/main` = `07c6f822ed` with the gate's own parser, printed per line rather than counted — 10 files name `ADR-0008`, in 17 citation rows:

| spelling | rows |
|---|---|
| already `cloud ADR-0008` | `CHANGELOG.md:5229` · `src/cloud-connection-ui.ts:8` · `src/connection-credential-store.ts:5` · `src/connection-credential-store.test.ts:5` |
| bare | `CHANGELOG.md:5228` · `README.md:3` · `README.md:189` · `package.json:5` · `src/cloud-connection-plugin.test.ts:4` · `src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts:5,21,24,54` · `src/cloud-connection-route-ledger.ts:103,128` · `src/index.ts:5,77` |

So the defect surface is narrower than the file count suggests: 12 bare rows in 7 files, of which 11 rows in 6 files are fixed here and one is excluded below. Three of the ten files already used the compliant spelling.

Bare `ADR-0008` resolves, in this repository, to `docs/adr/0008-metadata-repository-and-change-log.md` — *Metadata Repository, Change Log & Subscription (M0 → M4)*. Grepped in that record and printed: zero lines matching `control plane`, zero matching `cloud-connection`, zero matching `Phase 1` or `Phase 2`; the lit control `change log` returns lines, so the instrument is alive and those three zeros are real.

`README.md:189` is the row the card starred: it said "in the cloud repository" and wrote the number bare in the same sentence. It now reads

```
See `docs/adr` in the cloud repository (cloud ADR-0008) for the full architecture
decision.
```

## Site two — bare `ADR-0003` in `platform-object-names.test.ts`

The card grades this one 「成色弱一些」, and kept its own dev's wording off the record for overstating it. **This PR keeps the two gradings apart and does not assert one confidence for both.**

Exactly one row, re-derived: `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts:132`, `// They live in @objectstack/service-tenant (cloud repo, ADR-0003). If one`. The parenthetical names the cloud repo and writes the number bare, the same shape as the precedent card.

What was re-measured in `docs/adr/0003-package-as-first-class-citizen.md`, printed:

- title *Package as First-Class Citizen with Versioned Releases*;
- `platform object` — zero lines;
- `service-tenant` — three lines (7, 193, 194), so it is **not** unrelated, and the card's own downgrade holds. Line 194 is the load-bearing one: it records that `packages/services/service-tenant/` **left this repository** for `objectstack-ai/cloud` in `473fce590`;
- lit control `package` returns many lines.

So the local record is real and adjacent, and still is not the decision the comment cites. The line is now `(cloud repo, cloud ADR-0003)` — minimal insertion, per the precedent, rather than a prose rewrite.

⚠️ The other half stays **NOT MEASURED**, exactly as #18685 recorded it: which record `cloud ADR-0003` and `cloud ADR-0008` name in `objectstack-ai/cloud` was not read, because that repository is outside this session's scope. What is measured is where the bare number lands here.

## Bounded in-place fix, declared: bare `ADR-0007` and `ADR-0009` in the same files

Not on the card's face, done here under the bounded in-place-fix exemption and named rather than folded in silently. Same defect class, same package, same gate family, no new verification surface, and the dispatch measured zero open PRs holding any file under `packages/cloud-connection/`.

Six rows, re-derived on `origin/main`:

| number | bare rows | rows in this package that already carry `cloud` |
|---|---|---|
| `ADR-0007` | `src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts:591,631` · `src/index.ts:39` · `src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:178` | `src/local-manifest-source.ts:5` · `src/local-manifest-source.test.ts:4` · `CHANGELOG.md:5231` |
| `ADR-0009` | `src/marketplace-ui.ts:16,43` | `src/cloud-connection-route-ledger.ts:192` · `src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:219` · `src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts:203` · `src/marketplace-ui.ts:4` · `CHANGELOG.md:5230,5232` |

The evidence that these numbers name cloud decisions is in the tree, not in judgement:

- `src/index.ts:39` said `// ADR-0007 step ⑤ — the local desired-state ledger` while `src/local-manifest-source.ts:5` — the file that *implements* that ledger — said `(cloud ADR-0007 step ⑤)`. One citation, two spellings, same subject.
- This repo's own `docs/adr/0003-package-as-first-class-citizen.md` status line names it directly: "**revised by cloud ADR-0007 (2026-06-12)**: `sys_package_installation` is hereby redefined as desired state owned by the management plane … the `LocalManifestSource` ledger in `@objectstack/cloud-connection` for self-hosted runtimes". Read only, never edited.
- `src/marketplace-ui.ts` carried both spellings **inside one file**: `cloud ADR-0009` in its header on line 4, bare on lines 16 and 43, with `CHANGELOG.md:5230` spelling the very same `P2a` token qualified.

Read against this registry the bare numbers again land on real, unrelated records — `docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md` (*Settings — Manifest + K/V Store + Resolver*) and `docs/adr/0009-execution-pinned-metadata.md` (*Execution-Pinned Metadata*).

**A neighbouring citation that was checked and left alone:** `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts:202` cites a bare `ADR-0007` too, but it means *this* repo — the comment says so ("this repo's governed records") and the claim is true: `docs/adr/0007-settings-manifest-and-kv-store.md` really does carry an inventory table whose rows read `✅ exists`, printed. Left byte-identical.

## `CHANGELOG.md` is deliberately excluded

`packages/cloud-connection/CHANGELOG.md:5228` still cites `ADR-0008` bare. It is the one bare cloud citation left in the package, and leaving it is the rule, not an oversight: AGENTS.md routes `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` as RELEASE-OWNED — "❌ Never edit in a code PR", and a factual error in a released entry is amended "in a dedicated docs-only PR, ⛔ never an erratum in a later entry and never a rider on code changes". The same-class precedent did the same thing and said so in its changeset: "Historical archives — the six package CHANGELOGs — are deliberately untouched."

## What was measured

Verified at `f14281a519`.

- **Build** — `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@objectstack/cloud-connection..." build`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Tests** — `@objectstack/cloud-connection`: 29 files / 374 tests passed. `packages/spec`: `platform-object-names.test.ts` 1 file / 10 tests passed. ⚠️ The first spec attempt named `--project local` and the repo's own guard printed `FILTER SELECTED NOTHING`; that run measured nothing and is recorded as such. The file lives in the `repo` project and the number above is from the re-run.
- **Typecheck** — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0. `@objectstack/cloud-connection` declares no `typecheck` script, so it has none to run.
- **Gates** — the 91 families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this change set, reconciled back through `--ran`: 90 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED — `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/`. That needs a whole-repo build and is CI's run, not a failed measurement.
- **Citation gate, before and after** — `check-adr-anchors` on `07c6f822ed` read `36548 citation(s) across 4698 file(s)`; on this branch it reads `36556 citation(s) across 4699 file(s)`, exit 0 both times. The delta is fully accounted for: the sweep moves citations between spellings without adding or dropping any, and the one new file is this PR's changeset, whose 8 citations the same parser prints.
- **Three gates outside the derivation, run because this diff implicates them** — `check:adr-anchors`, `check:published-readme-exports` (a `README.md` edit) and `check:route-ledger-census` (a route-ledger edit): all exit 0.
- **Lint, narrowed and declared** — `eslint --no-inline-config --no-warn-ignored --format json` over all 10 changed paths. ESLint's own resolution linted **7** of them (the JSON result array length; the three it left out are two `.md` files and a `.json`, outside the config's `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']` glob): 0 errors, 0 warnings, exit 0. The narrowing excludes nothing, and the config says why in its own words — this repo "runs one `eslint.config.mjs`, which never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file, test or not" — so a comment-text edit inside these 7 files cannot move the verdict of a file it did not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run remains CI's.
- **Control bytes** — `pnpm check:nul-bytes` exit 0, plus a direct `grep -naP '[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'` over every changed path: no hits.
- **Published surface** — `@objectstack/cloud-connection` ships `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`. After the build, `dist/index.d.ts` carries `cloud ADR-0008` and `cloud ADR-0009` and no bare `ADR-0008`; the npm `description` and `README.md` carry the new spelling. So this publishes, and it ships as a `patch` changeset rather than `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Noted, not filed — every remaining bare `ADR-NNNN` in this package resolves to a record this repo really owns.** `ADR-0112`, `ADR-0120`, `ADR-0066`, `ADR-0104`, `ADR-0105`, `ADR-0093`, `ADR-0029`, `ADR-0036`, `ADR-0006` and `ADR-0005` carry no cloud-qualified sibling anywhere in the package, which is the evidence used above to identify a cloud number; with no such evidence there is no basis to re-point them. Whoever next touches these files is the carrier.
- **Noted, not filed — the sweep is package-scoped, by dispatch.** Card #14496 measured this population repo-wide at "60 files with a qualifier and ~110 more times bare"; this PR's surface is `packages/cloud-connection/**` plus the one spec test line, so the rest of that stock is untouched and still has no carrier card. Carrier: none — the issue this addresses says so in its own words, and choosing a repo-wide sweep is a maintainer's call, not this PR's.
- **For the seat to file (class b, violates a declared contract) — `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs`'s self-test never exercises the spellings its own exemption misses.** Reported on the open card #18761 and not re-filed here; named only so this PR's choice of the plain `cloud ADR-NNNN` form is traceable to it. Dedupe words: `check-adr-anchors`, `CROSS_REPO_QUALIFIERS`, cross-repo qualifier, self-test, line-wrapped qualifier.
